obfuscation_indicators: could result in closure of up to 10%
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively quantified but contains material uncertainty around the scope, timing, and cost of a multi-year network reconfiguration and workforce reduction. Planned volume declines from the largest customer, macroeconomic weakness, margin pressure, and restructuring costs present meaningful operating and execution risks, although management communicates a confident mitigation plan through pricing, higher-yielding volume, and targeted savings.
